subject: Thanks for the schedule switch
text: Hi, thanks again for switching the supply schedule when my train got delayed. It saved me from leaving the afternoon setup completely uncovered. I know it was a tiny ask, but it made a real difference on the day. I've labeled the extra clipboards for next week and tucked them under the registration desk, so you won't need to chase anyone for them. Also, if you still want the updated contact sheet, I can email it once I've checked the numbers twice. Let me know whether the new table layout worked or if you'd prefer I move it before the next round. Thanks
